summary.text: Ryan Fattman is a Republican state senator who has represented the Worcester and Hampden District since 2015 and is seeking re-election in the November 3, 2026 general election.
He previously served in the Massachusetts House of Representatives, representing the 18th Worcester District from 2011 to 2015.

paragraphs.text: Ryan Fattman's career experience includes work as a quality assurance analyst with the Mass Housing Finance Agency.
He has been affiliated with the National Conference of State Legislatures.
Fattman served in the state House from 2011 to 2015 and has been a state senator since.

In 2025-2026 he is the ranking minority member of the Senate Committee on the Census, the Senate Post Audit and Oversight Committee, the Senate Rules Committee, and several joint committees, including Election Laws, Revenue and Veterans and Federal Affairs.
